correctness.rationale: For a>-2,b!=0 the exact Chen–Li–Zhang global-center premise applies. A Poincaré–Lindstedt order-four resonant Fourier recurrence gives w2=3a/8-b²/24 and w4=5/16-21a²/256-ab²/384+b⁴/768. Independently symbolic inversion T/(2pi)=1-w2 A²+(w2²-w4)A⁴ verifies the stated coefficients and their universal -5/16 at a=b²/9. Analytic return-time and reversibility give an even analytic period in turning amplitude u=A². At mu=b²-9a, G(0,mu)=mu/24 and d_u G(0,0)=-5/8, so the implicit-function theorem yields exactly one local positive critical branch u*=mu/15+O(mu²) for mu>0, a strict local maximum with height 2pi+pi mu²/360+O(mu³). Correct original-time scaling x=A X,y=A³Y,s=A²t tends smoothly to X¨+X^5=0, whose transverse return is (2sqrt(3)/3)Beta(1/6,1/2), thus A²T tends to that constant; the finite A maximum for mu>0 follows by continuity. No claim of global uniqueness.
